# roams

**roams** provides functions for estimating parameters and detecting
outliers in state-space models using the ROAMS (Robust Outlier-Adjusted
Mean-Shift) framework. It includes functionality for fitting benchmark
models, visualizing model selection criteria, and evaluating in-sample
and out-of-sample performance. Simulation tools for generating synthetic
data under a first-differenced correlated random walk (DCRW) model are
also included. Designed with flexibility for user-defined model
structures via the
[`specify_SSM()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/specify_SSM.md)
interface.

See the corresponding ROAMS paper published in *Statistics and
Computing* here: <https://doi.org/10.1007/s11222-026-10935-4>

## Installation

You can install the development version of **roams** from GitHub with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("rajan-shankar/roams")
```

OR if using Windows:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("rajan-shankar/roams")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`attach_insample_info()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/attach_insample_info.md)
  : Attach In-Sample Information to Fitted State Space Model
- [`autoplot(`*`<roams_SSM_list>`*`)`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/autoplot.roams_SSM_list.md)
  : Autoplot for a ROAMS SSM List
- [`best_BIC_model()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/best_BIC_model.md)
  : Select Best Model Based on BIC
- [`classical_SSM()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/classical_SSM.md)
  : Classical State Space Model Fit
- [`get_attribute()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/get_attribute.md)
  : Extract Attributes from a ROAMS SSM List
- [`huber_robust_SSM()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/huber_robust_SSM.md)
  : Huber-Robust State Space Model Fit
- [`oos_filter()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/oos_filter.md)
  : Compute Out-of-Sample Inference for Fitted State Space Model
- [`oracle_SSM()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/oracle_SSM.md)
  : Oracle State Space Model Fit
- [`outlier_target_model()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/outlier_target_model.md)
  : Select Model Based on Target Outlier Proportion
- [`roams_SSM()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/roams_SSM.md)
  : Robust Outlier-Adjusted Mean-Shift Estimation of State Space Models
- [`simulate_data_study1()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/simulate_data_study1.md)
  : Simulate DCRW Data for Study 1: Different Outlier Configurations
- [`simulate_data_study2()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/simulate_data_study2.md)
  : Simulate DCRW Data for Study 2: Increasing Contamination and Varying
  Outlier Distance
- [`specify_SSM()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/specify_SSM.md)
  : Specify a State-Space Model in DLM Format
- [`trimmed_robust_SSM()`](https://rajan-shankar.github.io/roams/reference/trimmed_robust_SSM.md)
  : Trimmed-Robust State Space Model Fit
